name.ja: 1/72 VF-31J改 ジークフリード (ハヤテ機) デカルチャーVer.
name.en: 1/72 VF-31J Kai Siegfried (Hayate Custom) Deculture Ver.

description.ja: • 最終決戦でハヤテが搭乗したVF-31ジークフリードが1/72可変モデルで待望のキット化！
description.en: • VF-31 Siegfried, which Hayate piloted in the final battle, is now a long-awaited 1/72 variable model kit!

description.ja: • 大人気キャラ「フレイア・ヴィオン」が描かれたルンピカVer.デカルチャーデカールが付属する豪華版仕様で登場!!
description.en: • Lumpika version depicting the popular character "Freya Wion" comes in a deluxe version that comes with a deculture decal!!

description.ja: • メッサーへの思いが込められた、ハヤテ専用のマーキングも再現！ 三形態に対応したマーキング＆デカールが付属。
description.en: • Hayate's exclusive marking, which expresses his feelings for Messer, is also reproduced! Markings and decals compatible with the three forms are included.

description.ja: • 複雑な変形機構を支えるボディ構造には、一部に金属シャフトを使用。各部に内蔵したロック機構により、各形態を安定して保持することが可能。
description.en: • A metal shaft is used in part of the body structure that supports the complex deformation mechanism. Lock mechanisms built into each part allow each form to be held stably.

description.ja: • コックピットは複座・単座の選択式。フレイアと共に搭乗する様子も再現可能！
description.en: • Cockpit can be selected from two-seater or single-seater. You can also recreate the appearance of boarding with Freya!

accessories.en: Arm GUN (left and right) x 1 each
Seal de (left and right) x 1 each
[Front wheel x 1, rear wheel (left and right) x 1 each]

accessories.ja: アクションベース1用ジョイント×2
